source.title: Stalk With The Earthmother
source.description:
I have one last idea that may lead us to success.  I still feel there is hidden talent in you, but let us try and coax it out with a less direct approach.

Go and procure a Raw Brilliant Smallfish, then bring it back here.  Use these daggers to clean and fillet it.  Do not think too hard - do what comes naturally.
source.objective:
Buy or catch a Raw Brilliant Smallfish, then use the Knife Set to fillet it in front of Boarton Shadetotem in Thunder Bluff.

Provided item:
source.progress: Do you have something for me?
source.completion:
That was quite a display, <class>.  Not the rogueish precision I hoped for, but you possess an impressive ambidexterity.

I see now that you will not be the one to train my people in the subtle arts, but there is one thing I can teach you.  Good luck on your travels, <class>.  The Horde will need heroes like you.
